description: Fetch a GitHub user's or organization's public profile by username or profile URL, e.g. https://github.com/torvalds. Returns login, name, type (User/Organization), avatar, bio, company, blog, location, email, X/Twitter handle, all social accounts, exact public repo/gist counts, follower/following counts, and account creation date. Reads the rendered profile page and enriches exact counts from the GitHub API; no login required.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: GitHub username (e.g. torvalds) or the full profile URL https://github.com/torvalds.（用户名或主页完整 URL，如 torvalds 或 https://github.com/torvalds；用户与组织均支持。）
